_comment: OPERATOR ground truth — written from the deployment owner's stated intent (2026-07-12), independent of tags/resolver rules. Divergences vs the resolver are true semantic findings, not tautologies. See docs/BENCHMARK-RECALL.md.

_operator_notes.ensure_safety: 10 WiZ + siren + SMS. TVs/Ambilight must NOT act in an emergency (operator's explicit exclusion; they are display-capable but excluded by preference).
_operator_notes.alert_anomaly: Notify SMS; consult PIR/DHT and the TV binary sensors. HA-internal Sun/Backup sensors not wanted in this deployment (other deployments may declare otherwise).
_operator_notes.control_access: No locks in this deployment — nothing acts.
_operator_notes.notify: SMS only. TVs/Ambilight have no role here.
_operator_notes._pir_note: PIR IS included where relevant (read in an emergency is useful): the operator has a PIR and wants it read. Another deployment without a PIR simply would not register one.
